description: Mock Derivatives Service Bureau (DSB) UPI reference data used to evaluate EMIR validation rules R022 and R042 from validation_rules.json. In production these checks call the live DSB UPI reference service; this file stands in for that lookup in tests.
notes: R022 (ERROR) fails when the trade's UPI is not present in this table with status 'ACTIVE' as of the trade's ExecutionTimestamp.
R042 (WARNING) fires when lastRefreshDate is more than 180 days before the trade's ReportingTimestamp.
'ZZZUNKNOWN01' is intentionally absent from this table to simulate a UPI that does not exist in the DSB (NOT_FOUND) -- it is used by the R022 fail test row.
'IRSFIXFLTOLD' is present but deliberately stale (lastRefreshDate far in the past) -- it is used by the R042 warning test row.
